tasks.title: Protected forms accept bounded list fields and shared writes support incident and maintenance audit targets
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, contract pin, shared infrastructure in Behavior and unit Checks; Required behavior 1-3 (dispatcher, list fields, body limits and ApiCall), 10-11 (shared sender and People targets); Security impact (auth order, body limits and dependency pins). Pin contract to c4a2eb5214d48d40d0c1afbae5e3e49463185e15 or a later full main SHA containing 2.3.0 and regenerate bun.lock. Add optional ProtectedRoute.listFields and required PageRequest.lists, empty on GET/HEAD. Thread list parsing through the existing readFormFields/readPostForm pipeline in src/http-context.ts and protected dispatcher in src/server.ts; preserve callers without list fields and the fixed POST order. Add the two form limits, reject duplicate list values and over-limit counts, and never allow csrf/form_token as lists. Add the four ApiCall names and seven PeopleAction values and the incident/maintenance target encodings from section 11. Export/generalize the check sender and People-row helper with per-resource texts, optional revision and resource identifiers, keeping existing check write behavior and tests green. Update the existing PageRequest literal in token-write.test.ts with empty lists so the typecheck stays green at this step. This task supplies shared support only; resource-specific routes, outcome policies and calls follow in T2/T3. Update configuration docs for list-field validation and limits. The existing shared POST pipeline and regression suites are supporting paths beyond the plan's Files list, required to carry lists without duplicating the security checks.

tasks.title: People can inspect, publish, update, resolve and delete incidents with a live status-card preview
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, incident portion of Behavior, Fake API, Checks and Docs; Required behavior 1-10, incident portion of 11 and 14; Counterexamples through Private filtering; Acceptance evidence 1-2 and 4-7. Implement the complete incident vertical feature on T1's shared support: bounded public-only reads, first-failure states, 404-as-empty manual list, list filters/order/200-row bound, separate MTTR populations and duration formatting, manual timelines and read-only automatic detail/results, composer and automatic shortcut, post update, resolve and typed-title delete. Register exact raw-path protected routes and roles, validate query ids, and set incident navId; both navigation entries are enabled together in final T3 after both page families exist. Implement contract-based CRLF-normalized forms without trimming title/message, component validation, route/JSON byte limits and every outcome in section 10. Every accepted write is guarded immediately before the one outbound request; no If-Match for incidents, no retries or followed redirects, and section 11's id-only logs/People rows. Compose the resolve page in incident-pages.ts with existing html.ts field/error/button helpers; leave confirm.ts and its tests unchanged. Both open resolve GETs issue independent tokens; already-resolved update/resolve POSTs keep text and return 409 with zero writes, while a read/write resolution race shows the API's 409 after one write. Delete uses the shipped trim/NFC helper, known revision field equal to update count without a POST revision comparison. Implement escaped server preview and independent textContent live preview in the sole existing console script, unchanged CSP, one input/change listener, no request/storage/timer; resolved preview shows all updates and open preview the latest only. Add the stateful manual-incident fake with contract validation, auth, write counts, 100-update limit, private-item switch and resolve-after-read switch, reused by HTTP/browser fixtures. Add incident HTTP/unit/browser tests and docs in this task, including mobile/axe/focus, JS-server parity and no-JS flows; T3 extends the same fake/harness for maintenance. Cover all incident counterexamples and the per-route request counts in Performance impact.

tasks.title: People can plan and manage durable maintenance windows and both screen families pass final evidence checks
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, maintenance portion of Behavior and Fake API, navigation Checks, maintenance and whole-change Checks, Docs and Completion evidence; Required behavior 1-3 and 11-14; maintenance Counterexamples (Time parse through Phase boundary); Performance impact, Security impact, Rollout order 1 and Acceptance evidence 1-7. Build the Maintenance list, phase/source/shadowed views and all role-aware actions; create/edit with coherent maintenance/config revisions (one retry only), immutable id on edit, direct-check plus component selection snapshot, UTC round-trip parsing and unchanged millisecond preservation, contract validation, If-Match and maintenance-specific outcomes; delete database/shadowed copies with existing plainConfirmPage fields only. Enforce guards, list/body/JSON limits, stale input retention with zero window writes, unknown handling without retry and id-only People rows/logs. Extend T2's stateful fake with database/file/shadowed windows, injected phases, common revision and the exact API status semantics listed in Fake API. Register maintenance routes and enable both Incidents and Maintenance navigation entries together for every role; leave only Activity/System unavailable. Add maintenance unit/HTTP/browser tests beside implementation and extend fixture --serve for the complete manual journey. Finish docs, full suite/browser checks, required existing deploy-dev Compose job evidence, agent-browser lifecycle/mobile record and local-api smoke. The final security/evidence review covers all of T1-T3, including earlier incident tests and the maximum four API requests for the maintenance form retry. No API/contract/status product changes and no changes to confirm.ts or CSP.
